Evelyn T.: Follow-up from the 03/18 postmortem: we need final owners for remediation items and a decision on temporary SLO handling for p95 tail spikes.
Marcus J.: I can take the runtime fixes (KV eviction tuning + hotspot metrics). ETA ~72h for a staged rollout and perf validation.
Khaled R.: Ill own autoscaler and alerts. Plan: add short burst counter, shorten scale-up cooldown, and add an internal "operational buffer" SLO tile. ETA ~48h.
Evelyn T.: Proposal on SLOs: keep the public SLO unchanged but create an internal buffer SLO = 280ms for ops calculations for 14 days. Flag the incident window on the public dashboard so customers see a note but their SLA math remains untouched. Thoughts?
Marcus J.: Agree. Internal buffer avoids burning customer error budgets while we iterate. Ill include the dashboard flag in my PR.
Khaled R.: Draft alert for ops (staging):
```
alert: OperationalBufferedP95
expr: service:inference_p95_ms > 280
for: 5m
labels: {severity: "page"}
annotations: {runbook: "https://go/redwood/runbooks/kv-hotspot"}
```
Ill push to staging dashboards and keep public alerts as-is.
OncallBot: Incident 2026-03-18 | error budget impact: 4.2% | current p95: 312ms | incident link: https://go/redwood/incident/2026-0318
Evelyn T.: Action items: Marcus -> runtime PR + perf job (3d), Khaled -> autoscale + alert + dashboard (2d), Evelyn -> canary plan + rollback criteria (1d). Add ETAs to the postmortem ticket and tag @oncall for rollout window.
Marcus J.: PR draft: https://git.redwood/runtime/pulls/1582 - includes eviction changes and hotspot metrics. Running perf now.
Khaled R.: Infra PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/1107 - adds burst counter and cooldown tweak. Staging tile: https://dash.redwood/s/ops/operational-buffer. Canary ready after runtime merges.
Evelyn T.: Canary checklist: 1) update internal SLO docs, 2) 5% traffic for canary, 3) rollback if p95 > 350ms for 10m or errors +0.5%. Any blockers?
Marcus J.: No blockers. Perf run shows ~19% tail improvement on synthetic load. Finalizing patch in the morning.
Khaled R.: Scheduling canary 09:00 UTC tomorrow. Ill notify CS and SRE.
Evelyn T.: OK. After canary well decide whether to keep the buffer SLO for the 14-day window or restore original thresholds. Recording closure items in the postmortem ticket now. Thanks all :thumbsup:
